title: 获奖来源外站品牌指南、资源与可控演示
scope: Awwwards-linked external inner page; specific award status requires official evidence
goal: 理解品牌指南、资产权利与版本，可靠计算、复制、演示及下载原创示例。
workflow: 把指南内容、品牌资产许可、示范工具和真实产品规则分别记录，不因公开可读而推断允许分发。
核实导航开关及组合示例的局部内容变化；不要用整页截图差异代替作用区域与滚动证据。
为原创色板提供六位不透明 sRGB 对比度计算，使用原始比值判定并说明完整合规仍需其他检查。
复制必须等待设备确认；拒绝、缺失或超时提供可选文本。输入变化使旧计算及其下载失效。
动效仅明确启动，可暂停、继续或重置；减少动态时默认显示静态结果，尺寸或偏好变化取消旧运行。
编辑指南后同步生成完整静态内容及下载；断网、脚本失败、数据不符时仍可阅读并获得原创资源。
failure_recovery: 无效颜色不能沿用旧比值；复制失败不报成功；过期动画与复制确认不能覆盖当前状态；数据失败保留完整静态指南并可重试。
motion_contract: 无自动播放；提供暂停、继续、重置和明确选择；减少动态默认静态，改变视口或偏好取消旧运动；窄屏导航可关闭并恢复焦点。
source_relationship_note: An outbound work-detail association does not certify that every current inner page won an award or matches a historical version.
evidence_note: Only recorded observations are facts. DOM structure does not prove visual composition, hidden state, source code, backend behavior or licenses. The runnable blueprint is an original recipe, not a source-site clone.

acceptance: 理解品牌指南、资产权利与版本，可靠计算、复制、演示及下载原创示例。
无效颜色不能沿用旧比值；复制失败不报成功；过期动画与复制确认不能覆盖当前状态；数据失败保留完整静态指南并可重试。
无自动播放；提供暂停、继续、重置和明确选择；减少动态默认静态，改变视口或偏好取消旧运动；窄屏导航可关闭并恢复焦点。
320、390、768、1440 宽度不出现整页横溢出；必要表格在独立区域滚动。
键盘可进入、操作、关闭对话框并返回触发点；错误不只靠颜色。
本地预览不得暗示真实支付、投稿、消息、账户或预约已生效。
limitations: Source interaction audit is not automatically performed
Real backend, production and physical-device acceptance are not included

brand_contract.implementation: Original fictional Common Room guide, six authored colors, geometric symbols, SVG mark and local exports; no source assets
brand_contract.navigation: Complete native sections; optional mobile modal menu with Escape, section focus and desktop recovery
brand_contract.contrast: Opaque six-digit sRGB; .04045 linear threshold; raw ratio >=4.5 normal text or >=3 large text. Display floors two decimals; font eligibility and full WCAG require separate review
brand_contract.copy: Confirm device completion; manual selected text on absence, denial or timeout; obsolete confirmation ignored
brand_contract.motion: No autoplay; explicit run, pause/resume/reset; static end under reduced motion unless opted in; preference/viewport changes cancel prior run
brand_contract.fallback: All sections, six color tokens and original mark/CSS/JSON native downloads survive scripts/data failure; regenerate after guide.json edits
source_boundaries: Only guide identity, limited views, navigation open/close and local stack reconfiguration observed
Source copy, resource licensing, downloads, motion and errors untested
No source brand asset, exact design reconstruction or complete standards certification
